newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Carlsberg in Brazilian beer deal.
newsitem.headline: Danish Carlsberg in Brazilian beer deal.

text.p: Danish brewery giant Carlsberg A/S said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with Brazilian Cervejarias Reunidas Skol Caracu S.A. to produce and sell its beers in Brazil.
It said that it expected production and distribution of Carlsberg beers to start in Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro states in the first half of 1997, spreading to other regions later.

Cervejarias Reunidas is wholly owned by Companhia Cervejaria Brahma, Latin America's biggest brewery group, with annual sales of 40 million hectolitres and over 50 percent of the Brazilian market.--Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
